edits.before: Burning Q on poke and meeting the real engage with a shrug — the tornado is the matchup.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep Q Howling Gale banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Taric Cosmic Radiance is 180s at rank 1, 120s maxed — force fights before it's up, not after. - Dazzle (E) is 16s early, 12s maxed, with a long telegraph — dodge it and his stun combo resets. - Starlight's Touch heals off stacks, not a cooldown — deny stacks by dodging his Bravado-empowered autos.
